activation_conditions: 1. Owner approval of levels, weights and a budget (budget_usd is null). Nothing is live until then, and no order is ever placed by the committee.

2. TB2: owner confirms or rejects the 2026-11-12 ruling; if confirmed, the un-pause test (no credible Nvidia-knew report from the 12-01 to 12-03 sessions, no charge or admission naming Nvidia, permanent CEO named or credible timeline) must be met and approved by the owner.

3. TB3: owner rules the remote-access rule immaterial on evidence (licence grants for the large SG/MY operators or a company quantification of at-risk revenue) before ~2027-02-17, or rules TB3 not fired; never on price.

5. Accounting gate (applies whether or not TB5 is adopted): the Q3 10-Q is located and read (legal proceedings, any SEC disclosure, guarantee footnote); Nvidia has described the scope of the SEC matter or the 10-Q is silent on it with clean statements; no restatement, non-reliance, material weakness, auditor change or missed filing. If the owner adopts TB5, it must not be fired.
6. Data gate: sec_filings, the three technicals pages and tv_relative re-read in full; no activation on stale pages.
7. Pacing: no more than one third of total ladder weight (N1 + N2 = 2.5 of 7.5) before FOMC/CPI 2026-12-09/10; levels written down before the session they apply to, never changed intraday.
8. Earnings blackout: nothing new in the 3 trading days before the late-Feb 2027 print.
9. Invalidation (fundamentals): pause or drop N2-N4 if guarantees_paid rises above $0, Q4 revenue lands below $126.1B, or the next-FY growth forecast falls well below 75%.
